name: performance function
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 用于表达系统性能或极限状态与随机输入关系的函数。
usage_overview: 性能函数将结构响应与承载或位移限值联系起来，用于表达随机输入下的性能状态，并作为统计矩计算的对象，以描述其随机变化特征。

complete_examples.text: For example, a certain kind of linearization coefficients may provide different values in multi dimensions when the performance function is nonlinear.
It should be noted that the sampling techniques have less impact on evaluating the statistical moment of performance function using PCE model.
